findings.desc: External opt-in projects that configure root npm test as DONE-required are blocked by the self-host packages/main build-proof rule. Source: validateSelfHostBuildProof is called unconditionally from runDoneRequiredValidation and evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence in packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:346 and packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:440; it treats any root npm test receipt as requiring a preceding npm --prefix packages/main run build receipt. I built packages/main, then ran a temp external-project probe with doneRequiredCommands containing only npm test and a passing package.json test script; the command receipt exitCode was 0, but evidenceStatus was FAIL, reasons included missing-build-proof, evaluationStatus was fail, and blocking was true. This violates the documented external-project boundary in docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md:53-57: external projects explicitly opt into their own DONE-required policy, while the packages/main build proof is a self-host repository requirement.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 7ff8f9172 by making packages/main build proof explicit per command: external root npm test no longer inherits self-host proof, while self-host lattice.config.json marks packages/main build as providesBuildProof and root npm test as requiresBuildProof. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js, node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs, and npm test after nested-worktree smoke harness stabilization.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:459-478 evaluates only artifact-level status/hash fields and build-proof requirements for receipts that exist. It never verifies evidence.receipts.length or receipt identity against policy.commands. Verified with a /tmp fixture configured with two doneRequiredCommands (packages/main build providesBuildProof + root npm test requiresBuildProof): writing done-required-evidence.json with status=PASS, current policyHash/commandSetHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash, and receipts=[] makes evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence return ok=true/status=pass/detail=PASS with 0 required commands. This lets DONE accept a full-test proof artifact that contains no required command receipts, so the new DONE-required gate can be bypassed/corrupted instead of failing closed. Add a gate check that receipt count and each receipt label/command/args/cwd/shell/status correspond to the normalized policy command set before accepting PASS evidence, and cover empty/truncated/mismatched receipts in the smoke.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 89224d04d by adding receipt coverage and identity validation before accepting DONE-required PASS evidence. The evaluator now fails closed when receipts are missing, have the wrong count, mismatch command/args/cwd/shell, or report failed/nonzero/timedOut status, while preserving explicit self-host requiresBuildProof behavior. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js, node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs, node scripts/verify-nested-worktree-bootstrap.mjs, and npm test.

findings.desc: DONE-required evidence is not actually bound to the current HEAD. runDoneRequiredValidation writes top-level headHash and each receipt records headHash, and the requirements say evidence binds to headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash and stale head changes must block. But evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence only checks that evidence.headHash and currentHead exist at packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:533-536; it never compares evidence.headHash to currentHead. The smoke coverage exercises stale material/policy/command drift and receipt identity/status at packages/main/src/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.ts:196-287, but has no stale-head case. A previously generated done-required-evidence.json can therefore still satisfy DONE after a HEAD-only change if materialHash and storyFilesHash stay unchanged, undermining the DONE-required validation gate identity boundary.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in a04e9ffa63 by comparing evidence.headHash with the current git HEAD during evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence and failing closed with stale-headHash when they differ. Added smoke coverage that preserves material/story hashes while changing the evidence headHash and asserts blocking stale-headHash. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js, node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs, npm test, and verification_evidence_refresh_stale.

findings.desc: CHK-003 adversarial verificationIntent requires the DONE-required gate to block stale storyFilesHash evidence, but the refreshed smoke coverage does not assert that path. Source: packages/main/src/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.ts:272-287 only checks stale-material, policy-drift, and command-set-drift; rg finds no stale-storyFilesHash or missing-storyFilesHash assertion in the smoke. The evaluator branch exists at packages/main/src/core/done-required-validation.ts:539-540, but without a smoke assertion a DONE-required evidence artifact with stale storyFilesHash is not protected by the recorded validation coverage. Add a focused smoke case that writes fresh PASS done-required-evidence.json, changes story files hash without relying on material drift, and asserts evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence returns stale-storyFilesHash/blocking.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in a04e9ffa63 by adding a focused stale storyFilesHash smoke case to done-required-validation-smoke. The test rewrites only storyFilesHash in otherwise current PASS evidence and asserts evaluateDoneRequiredEvidence blocks with stale-storyFilesHash while materialHash and headHash remain current. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-required-validation-smoke.js, node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs, npm test, and verification_evidence_refresh_stale.

findings.desc: AGENTS.md remains a stale truth source for validation flow: AGENTS.md:561 says current validation is unified through `lattice validate`, while B-ac25 adds a separate opt-in DONE-required evidence path (`done_required_validate`) documented in testing-infra.md:53-57 and story-lifecycle.md:191/274-275. Because AGENTS.md is the project-level instruction file, later agents can be told to rely only on ordinary `lattice validate` and miss the DONE-required evidence command or overstate full-suite assurance. Update AGENTS.md to distinguish routine TEST `lattice validate` from opted-in DONE-required `lattice done_required_validate --storyId=<id>`, including advisory/no-full-suite behavior when no policy exists.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in a04e9ffa63 by updating AGENTS.md to distinguish routine TEST lattice validate from the opt-in DONE-required path. The project instruction now states that configured doneRequiredCommands / DONE-required policy require lattice done_required_validate --storyId=<id> before DONE, and that no policy is advisory/no full-suite assurance. Verified by docs reviewer finding source review, npm --prefix packages/main run build, done-required-validation smoke, process fact contract, npm test, and verification_evidence_refresh_stale.
